title: Making Waves: Blurgs AI Lands $2.2M to Supercharge Maritime Intelligence
summary: Blurgs AI has successfully raised $2.2 million in a funding round led by Pravega Ventures and Shastra VC to advance its AI-powered maritime intelligence platform. This capital will be used to expand commercial and defense capabilities, enhance global security, and scale its operations worldwide.
content:
In a significant boost for the burgeoning maritime tech sector, Blurgs AI, a startup at the forefront of intelligence services for the high seas, has successfully closed a $2.2 million funding round. This infusion of capital is set to propel the company's mission to revolutionize both commercial shipping and crucial defense operations through its sophisticated AI-powered platform.

The round was spearheaded by prominent venture capital firms Pravega Ventures and Shastra VC, with additional strategic participation indicating strong confidence in Blurgs AI's innovative approach. Navigating the world's oceans has never been more complex, challenged by geopolitical shifts, environmental concerns, and the sheer volume of global trade. Blurgs AI steps into this intricate landscape, offering real-time intelligence that empowers decision-makers.

For commercial clients, this means optimized routes, enhanced operational efficiency, and smarter resource management. For defense, it translates to heightened situational awareness, robust threat detection, and strengthened national security at sea. The $2.2 million will be strategically deployed to expand the core AI platform's capabilities, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in maritime data analysis.

A significant portion is earmarked for strengthening defense applications, ensuring nations have cutting-edge tools to protect their interests. Furthermore, Blurgs AI aims for an ambitious global scale-up, extending its reach to new international markets and solidifying its position as a vital player in maritime intelligence. This funding round isn't just about capital; it's a clear signal of the growing recognition for AI's transformative potential in safeguarding and streamlining our maritime future. With its advanced analytics and commitment to innovation, Blurgs AI is poised to make waves, ensuring safer, smarter, and more secure oceans for everyone.
keyTakeaways: Blurgs AI secured $2.2 million in a funding round led by Pravega Ventures and Shastra VC.
The startup develops AI-powered intelligence services for both commercial and defense maritime markets.
The funds will expand the platform's capabilities, strengthen defense applications, and support global scaling.
author: BL Chennai Bureau

title: Battlefield Bandwidth: Gilat Secures $11 Million in Critical U.S. Defense Contracts
summary: Gilat Satellite Networks has landed an $11 million series of orders from the U.S. Department of Defense, further solidifying its position as a vital provider of resilient, mission-critical connectivity. These contracts underscore the ongoing demand for Gilat's advanced field services, ruggedized terminals, and versatile multi-orbit satellite solutions essential for modern military operations.
content:
PETACH TIKVA, Israel – In a significant move cementing its strategic importance to national security, Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. (NASDAQ: GILT | TASE: GILT) announced on July 7, 2026, a fresh wave of orders totaling $11 million from the U.S. Department of Defense. This latest endorsement reinforces Gilat's crucial role as a premier provider of mission-critical communication infrastructure for military operations globally.

The substantial awards highlight the U.S. defense sector's continued reliance on Gilat Defense’s specialized offerings. These aren't just off-the-shelf components; they encompass a robust suite of field services, ultra-durable ruggedized terminals designed for the harshest environments, and cutting-edge resilient multi-orbit connectivity solutions. In an era where information superiority can dictate battlefield outcomes, ensuring uninterrupted, secure communication is paramount. Gilat's technology provides the digital lifeline that connects commanders with troops, facilitates real-time intelligence sharing, and supports complex logistical operations in often remote and challenging terrains.

What makes Gilat's solutions particularly attractive to defense agencies is their multi-orbit capability. This allows military units to seamlessly switch between different satellite constellations – geostationary, medium-Earth, and low-Earth orbit – providing unparalleled redundancy, reduced latency, and enhanced resilience against potential adversaries attempting to disrupt communications. This adaptability is no longer a luxury but a necessity for modern warfare, offering a critical layer of defense against sophisticated jamming attempts and ensuring continuous operational readiness.

For Gilat, these new contracts represent more than just a financial boost; they validate the company’s ongoing innovation in satellite networking. It signals a sustained demand for their robust, future-proof communication technologies within the defense sector, positioning Gilat as an indispensable partner in the evolving landscape of global security. As militaries increasingly rely on advanced digital tools, Gilat's expertise in delivering reliable, adaptable, and secure satellite communication remains a cornerstone of strategic advantage.
keyTakeaways: Gilat Satellite Networks secured $11 million in new orders from the U.S. Department of Defense.
The contracts involve advanced field services, ruggedized terminals, and resilient multi-orbit connectivity solutions.
This highlights Gilat's critical role in providing essential, adaptable satellite communication for modern military operations.
author: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd.

title: Breaking the Mold: Darla Booher's Historic Rise Amplifies Solera's Push for Women in Auto
summary: The Solera Foundation's Women in Dealerships (WIND) movement marked its first anniversary, celebrating significant strides in empowering women within the automotive retail sector. This milestone was highlighted by the historic installation of Darla Booher as NIADA President, making her only the third woman in eight decades to hold the position.
content:
Denver buzzed with a different kind of energy at the recent NIADA Convention, marking not just another industry gathering but a significant turning point for diversity within automotive retail. At its heart was the Solera Foundation’s Women in Dealerships (WIND) movement, which celebrated its impactful first year, spotlighting an inspiring leader whose ascent is poised to reshape the industry: Darla Booher.

Booher's story is remarkable. Newly installed as President of the National Independent Automobile Dealers Association (NIADA), she steps into a role held by only two other women in the organization’s 80-year history. This isn't just a ceremonial title; it's a powerful statement in a sector traditionally dominated by men. Her leadership embodies the very spirit of WIND, which was founded by Solera to foster a supportive network, mentorship, and career growth for women across the globe working in dealerships.

Over the past year, WIND has rapidly become a vital platform, offering resources and a community for professional development. Its initiatives are designed to dismantle barriers and provide pathways for women to thrive, recognizing that diverse leadership drives innovation and better business outcomes. Booher's elevation serves as a beacon, illustrating the tangible impact such movements can have when backed by proactive organizations like the Solera Foundation.

Her presidency, championed at the NIADA anniversary, isn't just a victory for Booher but a clarion call for continued progress. It signals a future where the automotive industry reflects a broader spectrum of voices and perspectives, ultimately strengthening the entire sector. With leaders like Booher at the helm and movements like WIND empowering the next generation, the road ahead for women in dealerships looks brighter and more inclusive than ever before.
keyTakeaways: The Solera Foundation's WIND movement celebrated its one-year anniversary, successfully advancing women's empowerment in automotive dealerships.
Darla Booher made history as only the third woman in 80 years to be installed as President of the National Independent Automobile Dealers Association (NIADA).
Booher's leadership and the WIND movement highlight a significant push towards greater diversity and inclusion within the traditionally male-dominated automotive industry.
author: GlobeNewswire
